_provenance: Hand-built and sealed 2026-09-26 for issue #51 (length-aware relevance floor). Every question is invented; every expected_ids entry names a real document in src/pravrudhi/assets/nyaya/*.json (IPC, COI, BNS, BNSS), checked by hand against that document's own text before this file was committed. Written and committed BEFORE any candidate rule (self-score normalisation / term-coverage / top-1-top-2 margin) was run against it -- see tests/test_nyaya_relevance_calibration.py's own docstring for the anti-overfitting discipline this enforces. expected_ids: [] means a genuinely uncovered question -- retrieve() should return nothing, not the nearest noise. kind: on_topic (a real question with a real match), off_topic (short, unrelated, no shared legal vocabulary), off_topic_verbose (unrelated but padded with real corpus vocabulary -- the false-citation risk issue #51 is about). Widened 5 expected_ids entries once, before any candidate rule was run, after checking plain BM25 top-1 by hand against each: several IPC provisions have an exact-doctrine BNS successor (dowry death IPC 304B / BNS 80, criminal conspiracy IPC 120B / BNS 61, culpable-homicide-not-murder IPC 304 / BNS 105/110, and the false-promise-of-marriage overlap between IPC 375 and BNS 69) -- the same widening PR #30 (08a3d20) already applied to its own regression tests for the identical reason (both code families genuinely apply). No candidate rule (self-score normalisation / coverage / margin) was computed before this correction.
